description: apply_outcome_feedback() fan-out matrix: which downstream actions are triggered for each evaluation_status
note: inconclusive and pending are both no-ops in apply_outcome_feedback(). ineffective raises priority more than effective.

cases.name: pending_is_noop
cases.description: pending evaluation: apply_outcome_feedback returns immediately without any fan-out

cases.name: inconclusive_is_noop
cases.description: inconclusive evaluation: same as pending, apply_outcome_feedback returns without fan-out

cases.name: effective_triggers_all_downstream
cases.description: effective evaluation: all downstream actions triggered (with services available)

cases.name: effective_no_skill_package_below_threshold
cases.description: effective but priority_score < 0.7 after delta: no skill package created

cases.name: effective_no_skill_package_no_duplicates
cases.description: effective with high priority_score but duplicate_count=0: no skill package created

cases.name: ineffective_triggers_needs_review
cases.description: ineffective evaluation: priority raised more (+0.15), status set to needs_review
